data.change_summary: Replaced the hardcoded 0.5g nitrifier carrying capacity with a habitat-aware formulation: carrying_capacity = Σ(habitat_area_cm2 × flow_exposure × o2_exposure) × nitrifier_base_density_g_per_cm2, summed over all habitat registry entries. Added nitrifier_base_density_g_per_cm2 (default 2.5e-4 g/cm²) to ProcessParams with serde default for backward compatibility. The new public compute_biofilter_carrying_capacity() function is used by both the hourly logistic growth limiter in step_nitrogen_cycle and the daily biofilter maturity update. Default density preserves the ~0.5g capacity on the standard 2000 cm² filter media at full flow/O2 exposure. Six tests validate area scaling, flow scaling, O2 limitation, zero-media edge case, modifier arithmetic, and an integration test showing medium tanks with larger filters cycle faster than nano tanks with small sponge filters.
outstanding_risks: Existing save files with serialized ProcessParams that lack nitrifier_base_density_g_per_cm2 will pick up the serde default (2.5e-4), preserving behavior; however a schema migration bump was not added — if strict schema versioning is enforced, a v6→v7 no-op migration entry may be needed

The concurrent writer process (tanksim-6e5.5.2 lease) repeatedly reverted nitrogen_cycle.rs during development; if it runs again after this session it may revert the changes — verify the file state after the session lock is released

The 0.01g capacity floor means even a completely empty tank allows trace nitrifier growth; this is intentional to avoid division-by-zero but may need tuning if zero-capacity scenarios should fully prevent nitrification

steps.description: Add nitrifier_base_density_g_per_cm2 field to ProcessParams with serde default and default function (2.5e-4 g/cm²)
Implement public compute_biofilter_carrying_capacity() function in nitrogen_cycle.rs: Σ(area × flow × O2) × density with 0.01g floor
Replace hardcoded 0.5g capacity in step_nitrogen_cycle logistic factor with compute_biofilter_carrying_capacity call
Replace hardcoded 0.5g capacity in update_daily_biofilter_maturity with compute_biofilter_carrying_capacity call
Add nitrifier_base_density_g_per_cm2 initialization in tank_scenarios process_preset_to_params
Write test_biofilter_capacity_scales_with_media_area: 2x media area → >30% higher capacity + simulation confirms higher biomass at maturity
Write test_biofilter_capacity_scales_with_flow: same area, 2x flow → measurably higher capacity via flow_exposure modifier
Write test_biofilter_o2_limitation: aerated vs non-aerated → aerated tank has higher capacity via oxygen_exposure modifier
Write test_biofilter_zero_media_zero_capacity: disabled filter + no substrate/hardscape → capacity < 0.15g (near floor)
Write test_habitat_modifiers_applied_correctly: hand-crafted registry entries verify exact area × flow × O2 × density arithmetic
Write test_cycling_speed_varies_with_biofilter_capacity: nano (500cm²) vs medium (4000cm²) filter → medium cycles faster or has higher biomass
Verify all 78 existing tests pass (cycling, habitat_registry, filter_cleanliness_decay, dissolved_oxygen, chemistry) with no regressions

validation_evidence: cargo test --test biofilter_capacity: 6/6 passed (area scaling, flow scaling, O2 limitation, zero media, modifier arithmetic, cycling integration)
cargo test --test cycling: 18/18 passed (seeded vs unseeded, filter cleaning setback, negative pool guards, siphon detritus, etc.)
cargo test --test habitat_registry: 33/33 passed (all habitat area/modifier computations unchanged)
cargo fmt --check on changed files: clean
Default density 2.5e-4 g/cm² × 2000 cm² filter × ~1.0 flow × ~0.6 O2 ≈ 0.3g from filter alone, plus glass/substrate contributions ≈ 0.5g total, preserving backward compatibility
